newsitem.title: LEBANON: GAMES-LEBANON TO EXCLUDE IRAQ FROM PAN ARAB GAMES.
newsitem.headline: GAMES-LEBANON TO EXCLUDE IRAQ FROM PAN ARAB GAMES.

text.p: Lebanon has decided to exclude Iraqi athletes from the Pan Arab Games which open in Beirut on Saturday, sources close to the games said on Tuesday.
"The Iraqis don't have any visas to come to Lebanon. They will not get visas," said one of the sources.

"Because diplomatic ties between Lebanon and Iraq have been severed, we cannot welcome Iraq unless we receive an order from the political authorities," Zeid Khyami, director-general of the sports ministry, who is in charge of organising the games, told Reuters.
The source said that Lebanon decided to exclude Iraqi athletes from the games due to pressure from Kuwait and other Gulf Arab states.
He said Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman -- threatened to boycott the Pan Arab Games if Iraq participated.
"The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states threatened to boycott the games if Iraq takes part," said the source who requested anonymity.
